allowed_hosts: git remotes of repositories checked by GIT_CHECKER

scripts.purpose: Produces a read-only Arch Linux maintenance report covering updates, caches, services, timers, journals, filesystems, backups, Timeshift snapshots, and Git status, then resets the local maintenance reminder state. It never installs, upgrades, removes, or cleans anything.

arguments.name: -c|--config-file FILE
arguments.description: Load settings from FILE; a missing value exits 2.

arguments.name: --config-file=FILE
arguments.description: Equivalent to -c FILE; an empty value exits 2.

environment.name: USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG
environment.description: Config file path used when no config-file option is given.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.description: Base directory for the installed config lookup.

environment.name: MAX_BACKUP_AGE_DAYS
environment.description: Age in days at which the newest backup counts as overdue.

environment.name: MIN_SNAPSHOTS
environment.description: Minimum number of Timeshift snapshots required.

environment.name: MAX_SNAPSHOT_AGE_DAYS
environment.description: Age in days at which the newest snapshot counts as too old.

environment.name: GIT_CHECKER
environment.description: Executable used for the Git repository check.

environment.name: STATE_DIR
environment.description: Directory holding the maintenance countdown and pending marker.

network_hosts: git remotes of repositories checked by GIT_CHECKER

exit_codes.meaning: Help printed or the report completed; individual checks may print warnings or errors without changing the exit status.
Run as root, pacman missing, or config file unreadable.
A config-file option was supplied without a non-empty value.
